prompt: Who was the last Miss World America to place in the Top 11 at Miss World? Hint: She has pursued a modeling career.
answer: **Audra Mari**, Miss World America 2016. She represented the United States at Miss World 2016 and finished in the **Top 11**. She later pursued a career as a model and television host.
